meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 收到本地 Word、PPT、Excel 等附件时，会先在容器内把它们转成 Markdown 再读取，无需把文件上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当你要求读取或处理本地 Word、PPT、Excel 等附件而不想上传时触发。

say.text: 把本地 docx 转成 Markdown，然后总结要点。
读取我发的 PPTX，把每页标题列出来。
say.note: 输出标题列表供你浏览。

say.text: 把附件 CSV 转成 Markdown 并告诉我数据概况。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude converts local attachments like Word, PPT, Excel into Markdown inside the container before reading or processing them, without uploading files to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to read or process local document attachments (e.g., docx, PPT, Excel) without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert this local docx to Markdown, then summarize key points.
Read the PPTX I attached and list slide titles.
Convert the attached CSV to Markdown and give an overview.
